projects.name: SilverScript Studio
projects.tagline: Write, compile & deploy covenants in the browser
projects.shows: A zero-install Silverscript IDE: annotated snippets, eight covenant wizards (time-locked vault, escrow, dead man's switch…), an AI assistant, and one-key compile with a hex inspector — plus wallet-connect deploy, deposit and withdraw flows.

checks.what: in-browser compiler exercised — the welcome contract compiled to 56 bytes

projects.note: deploy/deposit/withdraw are the site's own claims, not yet independently tested · no public source found · was unreachable on 2026-09-24, back up since · by Kaspero Labs (confirmed on their site)

projects.name: DAGmate
projects.shows: Match escrow is a covenant with a trustless timeout forfeit — proven on testnet-10, then mainnet. The chain enforces the win.

checks.what: mainnet escrow spends

projects.name: Dagger
projects.shows: Trades KCC-20 tokens across the L1 venues from a Telegram bot — every trade verifiable on kascov.

checks.what: mainnet trades visible on kascov

projects.name: Koracle
projects.shows: A named oracle signing facts with BIP340 and settling them into covenants and hashlocks — with its own four-tier honesty labels.

checks.what: signed feeds observed live

projects.note: listed on its public claims — no code or on-chain check yet

projects.name: Warda Protocol
projects.shows: An agent's budget compiled into the coin's script: a spend outside the cap is not refused — it is not a transaction.
projects.note: testnet-10, unaudited by its own statement

projects.name: Kaspire wallet
projects.shows: KCC-20 discovery and operations built on the Silverscript template — mainnet and testnet-10.

projects.name: DagSphere
projects.shows: Live holder maps for every KCC-20 token — bubbles by share of supply, funding-cluster detection, deployer tags. Read-only by design.

checks.what: read-only chain data; free access code via the Dagger bot

projects.name: KasProof
projects.tagline: Stamp any file onto the DAG
projects.shows: Your file is hashed in the browser, the hash becomes a Kaspa address, one transaction becomes a permanent timestamp anyone can verify — the file itself never leaves your device.

checks.what: mainnet connect observed

projects.name: Kassword
projects.tagline: A post-quantum vault on the DAG
projects.shows: Passwords, IDs and files encrypted in your browser with NIST post-quantum ciphers, then backed up as sealed noise onto the Kaspa BlockDAG — no accounts, no Kassword servers.

projects.name: KasRanks
projects.shows: An NFT collection where your rank is assigned by how much KAS your wallet holds — 782 handcrafted sea creatures across 11 tiers, from Plankton to Aquaman, native on the DAG.

projects.name: Enclave
projects.shows: A wallet built around understanding what you sign: SureSign spells out a transaction's effects before you approve, Deal Desk holds agreements in encrypted escrow rooms, and vaults carry defined access and inheritance terms.
projects.note: in active development · source not yet public

projects.name: ForgeVault
projects.tagline: Token locks & vesting, enforced by script
projects.shows: Lock or vest any KCC-20 token: the tokens sit at a P2SH script address and move only with the beneficiary's signature after the unlock point — no server or admin key can release them early. Their own docs say it straight: a plain script, not a covenant, and not independently audited.

checks.what: contracts parse-checked against silverc v1.0.0 in CI
mainnet lock transaction verified

projects.note: the first listing to arrive through the public issue flow — suggested and verified the same day

projects.name: KasWare
projects.tagline: The wallet with a documented KCC-20 API
projects.shows: Browser and mobile wallet exposing signKcc20Deploy / Mint / Transfer over PSKT for dApps — and its vault covenants are the single biggest covenant family on mainnet.

checks.what: KasWare vault covenant templates named on mainnet by the kascov indexer (180k+ instances)

projects.name: dotK
projects.shows: A name registry where each .k name is a covenant deed UTXO and uniqueness is enforced by the chain itself — owner schemes follow KCC-2.

checks.what: supertypo/dotk-covenants

projects.name: Kaspa Kii — Impulse
projects.shows: Open-source DvP settlement: both legs of a trade settle in one transaction, or each side gets refunded — no escrow agent in the loop.

checks.what: KaspaKii/impulse

projects.note: mainnet deployment is the project’s own report (v0.4.0) — not yet independently verified on chain by this site

projects.name: Kaspero Labs
projects.shows: kaspa-redteam for attacking and testing Silverscript contracts, KCC-20 wallet-hardening guidance, and a covenant bridge experiment verifying Ethereum finality with RISC Zero proofs.
projects.note: also the team behind SilverScript Studio

projects.name: Karat
projects.tagline: Recompiles every token, grades what the chain proves
projects.shows: Recompiles each KCC-20 contract with silverc, byte-matches it against a template registry, and grades mint authority, supply and ownership from 24K down to Counterfeit.
projects.note: the grades are its own methodology, not an audit; its public API is marked coming soon

venues.name: KRON
venues.shows: Swap KCC-20 tokens against a permanently-locked AMM, or launch your own on a rug-proof bonding curve — live charts per token.

checks.what: mainnet trades verified on chain

venues.note: covenants audited by Hashlock (Sept 2026, rated Secure: 24 findings, 20 fixed and re-verified) — the scope excludes the standard KCC-20 family and vesting; full report + SHA-256 at kron.technology/audit

venues.name: KaspaRocket
venues.shows: Tokens climb a dual-phase bonding curve, then graduate to a constant-product AMM — the venue publishes its Silverscript contracts, and its lp-amm covenants run on mainnet.

checks.what: 180 KaspaRocket lp-amm covenants live on mainnet, attributed by the kascov indexer
contracts parse-checked in CI

venues.name: Zealous Swap
venues.shows: Protocol-owned liquidity, an insurance fund and NFT-based fees — a DEX with launchpad built for the long game.

checks.what: buy, sell and launch on testnet-10

venues.name: KForge
venues.tagline: Forge a token, watch it graduate
venues.shows: A launchpad and DEX built entirely from Kaspa covenants — the script holding the funds enforces the price. Now live on mainnet.

checks.what: mainnet trades executed and verified via the Dagger integration

venues.note: kascov’s venue feed has not yet named it — that attribution check is pending

venues.name: Braid (formerly KaspaKaha)
venues.tagline: Best-price swaps across the L1 venues
venues.shows: A swap aggregator that routes across KRON, KaspaRocket and KasSeal through an on-chain router — you get your minimum or a refund. The team’s open-source KCC-20 reference build and AMM remain on testnet-10.

checks.what: buy + sell proven on testnet-10, as KaspaKaha
the KCC-20 reference build (KaspaKaha/KCC20) — no public repo for the Braid router itself

venues.note: rebranded from KaspaKaha in mid-October; the mainnet router itself is not yet independently verified on chain by this site

venues.name: KaspaCom
venues.shows: Tokens, NFTs, domains and a KCC20 covenant marketplace — plus its own covenant explorer at covenants.kaspa.com.

checks.what: KCC20 marketplace live on mainnet, observed

venues.name: KasSeal
venues.tagline: Fixed-supply launches on a linear curve
venues.shows: Every token launches as 1.2B fixed-supply KCC-20 — 800M on a linear curve, 400M reserved for the pool it graduates into.

checks.what: named as a mainnet venue by the kascov indexer’s venue feed
open-source TypeScript SDK (Sealkaspa/kasseal-sdk)

explorers.name: kascov.io
explorers.shows: Browse live covenants, KCC-20 holdings and trades — and try covenant code right in the browser, nothing to install.
explorers.note: also a data source for this site — the templates feed, refreshed every 4 hours

explorers.name: KaspaCom Covenant Explorer
explorers.shows: KCC20 listings, trades, transactions and UTXOs in one place — the marketplace hub's own window onto the chain.

explorers.name: kcc20.info
explorers.shows: Public JSON for tokens, holders, balances, covenant events and signing data — no API key, local-first, validated from a Kaspa node.
explorers.note: in constant use — the site’s mainnet numbers come from its API, refreshed every 4 hours; community reports point to Kasvio as its successor, and this site’s feed will migrate if it degrades

explorers.name: Kasvio
explorers.tagline: Covenant explorer for the whole network
explorers.shows: Explores all covenant activity (not only KCC-20), with token pages, alerts and token-to-token swap views.
explorers.note: community reports name it the successor to kcc20.info — unconfirmed by this site
